name: Blackened Salmon with Cajun-Spiced Beans, Rice & Tomato Relish

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season salmon with half of the spice mix on both sides. (Reserve remaining spice mix for the beans.)

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, place salmon, skin-side-down, in the skillet; cook until flesh is opaque and flaky, 3-4 minutes per side (depending on thickness). Once done, transfer to a plate and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 sticks celery
3 green bell peppers
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic and onions. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery. Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add both to the bowl with the garlic and onion.
Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and remaining spice mix; sauté until soft, about 8 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, small dice tomatoes and transfer to the reserved bowl. Add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the relish and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp apple cider vinegar
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add water and tomato paste to the skillet, stir to combine, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, add beans and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup water
3 tbsp tomato paste

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice and beans between plates; top with blackened salmon and tomato relish. Enjoy!
